checks.label: Lg16K speedup 256/48: K-019 vs Cycle 8
checks.root_cause: Severely inconsistent. K-019 shows 4.5% harm, Cycle 8 shows 38% harm. 61% difference cannot be explained by ROCm version alone. Possible causes: (1) different WS kernel version, (2) different comm mechanism (torch.copy_ vs Iris), (3) different concurrent launch methodology.
checks.impact_on_verdict: Lg16K NO-GO verdict is unanimous (both <1.0), but magnitude uncertainty is extreme
